name: WdParagraphAlignment
description: Specifies the alignment of a paragraph.

constants.name: wdAlignParagraphDistribute
constants.description: Paragraph characters are distributed to fill the entire width of the paragraph.

constants.name: wdAlignParagraphJustifyMed
constants.description: Justified with a medium character compression ratio.

constants.name: wdAlignParagraphJustifyHi
constants.description: Justified with a high character compression ratio.

constants.name: wdAlignParagraphJustifyLow
constants.description: Justified with a low character compression ratio.

constants.name: wdAlignParagraphThaiJustify
constants.description: Justified according to Thai formatting layout.
